dedupe_keys.name: i blend iiit delhi campus energy occupancy and weather

description: I-BLEND contains aggregate electricity measurements for seven buildings on the IIIT Delhi campus in India. The buildings include academic and lecture facilities, a library, dining facilities and student dormitories. The research team also deposits occupancy observations, weather from the campus and Delhi airport, and the institute calendar. Figshare groups four deposits, all marked CC0 with free access. Energy and occupancy observations are packaged in ZIP files, with documentation inside the packages, while the calendar is supplied as CSV. The inspected repository pages do not establish a common measurement interval or the complete calendar span, so those details remain unverified without the packaged documentation. The collection can calibrate campus electricity-demand and occupancy-driven building simulations, extending the household focus of data-uk-dale-domestic-appliance-level-electricity. A caveat is that a university campus has activity patterns unlike a general commercial or residential population. Weather and occupancy coverage may also differ from electricity coverage. No measurement package was downloaded or executed.
